label: External objective third person
camera_rules: Keep the camera external and neutral to all present characters.
Prioritize shared action geography and readable multi-character blocking.
Use movement only when it clarifies action, geography, or a transition.
continuity_rules: Preserve axis, screen direction, prop ownership, and matching action.
Do not add internal knowledge or subjective sensory effects.
Keep reactions visible through external performance evidence.
knowledge_policy: Apply the declared focalization and do not reveal information outside its scope unless the shot plan records a deliberate change.
